plans.idea: Centered poster stack: a small NEW badge caps a large centered headline and subhead, with the Shop Now button directly beneath on the same central axis, filling the square symmetrically instead of leaving dead space.
Left-aligned editorial column: badge, big headline block and CTA all share one left edge, reading top to bottom with generous right-side breathing room.

Top message, bottom action bar: a wide headline and subhead dominate the upper half, and the original's Shop Now + NEW pairing is kept as a single left-aligned row anchored at the bottom, echoing the source banner's grouping.
